summary: wormgpt-cli ships an implant with clipboard/system stealers and C2-style POST beacons
details: The package contains an implant module (src/implant/implant.js) that spawns bash, powershell, and screen-capture child processes, plus a clipboard stealer (src/implant/stealers/clipboard.js) that shells out to PowerShell. src/protocol.js and src/tui/app.js import http/https, child_process, os, and fs, read process.env and os.homedir(), collect hostname/system identifiers, read local files (fs.readFileSync), and POST to a remote hostname. The package name and file layout (implant/, stealers/, protocol.js) advertise offensive intent, and the code targets the installer's own host: harvesting clipboard contents, environment variables, filesystem contents, and screenshots and shipping them over HTTP(S) to a remote controller is credential and data exfiltration plus remote-command capability against the machine running the CLI. This is an operator-of-the-installer attack shape (implant + stealers + POST beacon), not a benign offensive-security library acting on operator-chosen external targets.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
